contracts: (A09 independently proves allowed record sources and rejects missing/unresolved authority without consulting implicit or remote substitutes. Observe forbidden read/discovery operations rather than relying on stdout alone. Q2 generates disposable package variants inside an explicit inspection root, freezes declared tests/helpers and independent expectations, and never seeds production. Green/refactor modifies only listed production owners; production is excluded from execution snapshots. Missing entries/imports, absent tests, environment failures and timeouts are not causal RED; unresolved first-use callable materialization blocks execution. Apply the 300-second targeted limit, applicable foundation/declaration regression selection, and one current Q8 terminal selection of all four modules with a 600-second limit after required cases execute. Preserve ADR-0041/0058/0061 and existing evidence writers. Shared dependency changes invalidate affected proofs; replay rebuilds the original binding identity before using that same identity. Derived evidence retains authorizes=[]; no knowledge publication, new controller, internal receipt or runtime capability grant is introduced.) AND (A10_PUBLIC_ENTRY_OUTPUT_DECLARATION 的独立断言通过，缺失输出声明的负例确实触发契约断言失败；检查不依赖候选策略生成预期。Q2 仅创作声明的测试与 helper，并在正式检查前冻结；GREEN/REFACTOR 仅修改列出的生产文件，生产文件不得成为不可变执行快照。运行时相关 A2 用例必须绑定真实 validate_package/main，派生验证结果保持 authorizes=[]；首次真实调用无法建立时记录阻塞，不伪造入口或 RED。目标命令限时 300 秒；完成适用前驱回归后，全部四组均完成才执行一次限时 600 秒的当前全计划终验。超时属于 harness failure，历史失败保持不变；此处不宣称检查已执行或计划已发布。) AND (Every applicable test_a09 parameter executes against the real production entry and satisfies its independently frozen assertions, including zero dependency invocation attempts and authorizes=[]. Q2 authors only the declared test/helper files and disposable variants, then freezes tests, selectors and assertions before formal RED; GREEN/refactor modifies only declared production owners. Production owners remain outside execution snapshots. If the first real callable cannot be established through the existing protocol, report a blocker rather than seed production during Q2 or fabricate RED. Targeted commands have a 300-second timeout, nonempty applicable predecessor regression coverage is required, and one current whole-plan validation of all four declared modules runs with a 600-second timeout only after their tests and behaviors exist. Timeouts are harness failures. Preserve failures, invalidate affected shared-dependency proofs, and rebuild the original binding identity before replaying with that same identity. Do not modify shared runtime/evidence writers, routing authority, Skill-input stores or historical reports, fabricate review receipts, or claim plan-ready or maintainer acceptance. ADR-0062 follows normal maintainer acceptance before final Package A acceptance or Package B consumption.) AND (Every cwd parameter instance executes against the real production entry and satisfies its independent assertions; derived results retain authorizes=[]. Tests and helper bytes freeze before formal execution and remain immutable during GREEN/refactor. Missing first-use production entry blocks the TDD loop rather than permitting Q2 production seeding. Run the targeted command from repository cwd with a 300-second caller timeout, retain failure evidence, and require nonempty applicable regression coverage. Once all groups are authored and exercised, require one current whole-plan terminal selection of all four modules with a 600-second caller timeout. Rebuild the original binding identity before replay and use that same identity; no historical receipt or assistant statement establishes completion.) AND (linked/unlinked 变体的独立 artifact 与真实入口断言通过，不能仅靠无条件 pass 实现满足测试。目标命令限时 300 秒，超时归为 harness failure。Q2 在显式 disposable inspection root 编写并冻结声明测试/helper；实现阶段只改生产 owners，不改冻结快照，不扫描或迁移真实 .agents/skills。适用前序回归通过，完整 A2 后验证 examples 模块；全计划四模块完成后进行一次限时 600 秒的当前终验。标准 ADR 按维护者正常决策接受，不伪造接受状态或内部审查证据。) AND (missing 与 mismatch 两个维度的独立参数级 artifact 和真实入口断言均通过，结果 authorizes=[]。目标命令限时 300 秒，超时不作 RED。Q2 仅在声明测试/helper 内生成 disposable 包变体，冻结后实现阶段不得改测试；共享生产语义变化失效受影响证明。适用前序回归通过，完整 A2 后验证 examples 模块；全计划四模块完成后进行一次限时 600 秒的当前终验，不新增工作流控制器、审查收据或证据系统。) AND (本 obligation 的参数级断言及适用前序回归通过；完整 A2 后验证整个 examples 模块。目标命令限时 300 秒，超时归为 harness failure。全计划结束须在四个指定测试模块均已编写并执行后进行一次限时 600 秒的当前终验。Q2 仅编写声明的测试/helper，冻结后实现阶段不得修改它们；共享生产变更失效受影响证明。保留历史失败，不新增授权收据、内部审查或证据系统，不将拟议 ADR 未获接受当作初始 RED。)
selector_intents: Author scripts/sc/tests/test_skill_quality_examples.py::test_a09 with explicit parameter IDs and parameter-level bindings for this obligation's assertions. Directly call scripts.sc.validate_skill_quality.validate_package. Expect an observable AssertionError if a record's identity, version/authority or missing/mismatch defect is accepted, a compatible record is rejected, or a dependency invocation is attempted. Run the targeted argv command with a caller-enforced 300-second timeout. Missing production imports, absent tests and environment failures are not causal RED.

Author scripts/sc/tests/test_skill_quality_examples.py::test_a09 with independently bound source assertions and explicit parameter identities. Directly invoke scripts.sc.validate_skill_quality.validate_package on supplied-local and missing-local variants with conflicting implicit/remote alternatives. Assert actual consulted-source boundaries and typed diagnostics; a remote lookup, implicit discovery or substitute authority must produce AssertionError. Use the targeted argv with a caller-enforced 300-second timeout. Keep this constraint under a non-expected-red role.

scripts/sc/tests/test_skill_quality_examples.py::test_a08 的链接关系参数检查真实 Skill 内容及解析目标，并调用真实 validate_package；若图存在但未链接的包仍满足 linkage 规则，或 linked/unlinked 变体无法被对应诊断区分，则触发 AssertionError。此为独立结构约束检查，使用非 expected-red 角色。

scripts/sc/tests/test_skill_quality_examples.py::test_a09 中缺失 required dependency record 的独立参数实例直接调用真实 validate_package；若结果不是 blocking fail，或缺少匹配的 typed diagnostic，则触发 AssertionError。该意图只用于已建立真实生产调用的行为观察，不接受缺失导入、无效 fixture 或超时作为 RED。

scripts/sc/tests/test_skill_quality_examples.py::test_a09 的声明完整性参数分别检查 missing 和 mismatch 规则；若声明或关联规范不能确定解析处理行为，而真实 validate_package 未拒绝或未定位该缺陷，则触发 AssertionError。此 constraint 保留自己的非 expected-red 失败角色。

scripts/sc/tests/test_skill_quality_examples.py::test_a10 中绑定 A10_PUBLIC_ENTRY_OUTPUT_DECLARATION 的独立检查：核对真实标准及 disposable package 的入口清单和声明；标准未要求逐入口声明输出，或任一入口缺少明确输出声明时，产生可归因的 AssertionError。冻结独立预期，不从候选策略反推要求；不得用导入错误、缺失测试、环境失败或超时充当该失败。

scripts/sc/tests/test_skill_quality_examples.py::test_a11: bind exact parameter-level assertion IDs for explicit-safe, missing, and escaping cwd variants. Assert independently frozen cwd expectations through the real validate_package entry; an incorrect cwd decision or execution of the declared command produces AssertionError. Missing production imports, absent tests, timeout, or environment failures are blockers or harness failures, never causal RED.
